searchText: Gm 😊, I’m a little new to writing EIPs, but a huge emerging problem I see is NFT / SBT spamming / friction to burning NFTs. In Solana, there is a concept called Rent where on transaction you pay a fee which would cover the cost of gas to burn an NFT. Burning gives a small reward to incentivize reporting spam. Do you think there would be interest in implement a similar improvement into Ethereum? The basic tl;dr of this EIP would be to increase the cost to mint a token to a wallet address to cover the gas to burn an token. I believe this should happen on the chain level regardless of the token standard. Here’s my post in Ethereum Magicians 😁 https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/demotivate-spam-and-incentivize-burning-unwanted-tokens/13167
